dose_adult.indication: Estados maníacos ou esquizofrênicos agudos (internação; via oral após controle inicial com injeção)
dose_adult.note: A bula diz que 500 mg/dia em geral bastam; aumentos graduais até 2.000 mg/dia ou mais podem ser necessários, com pouco ganho acima de 1.000 mg/dia por longos períodos. Doses menores em idosos e debilitados. Não há dose máxima fixa.

cite.locator: seção DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION – ADULTS: Acute Schizophrenic or Manic States
cite.quote: 500 mg a day is generally sufficient. While gradual increases to 2,000 mg a day or more may be necessary, there is usually little therapeutic gain to be achieved by exceeding 1,000 mg a day for extended periods.

cite.locator: Boxed warning: Increased mortality in elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis
cite.quote: Elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis treated with antipsychotic drugs are at an increased risk of death.
Tardive dyskinesia, a syndrome consisting of potentially irreversible, involuntary, dyskinetic movements, may develop in patients treated with antipsychotic drugs.
cite.note: Seção ADVERSE REACTIONS: "Neuromuscular reactions include dystonias, motor restlessness, pseudo-parkinsonism and tardive dyskinesia, and appear to be dose-related."

cite.quote: The use of chlorpromazine and other potential hepatotoxins should be avoided in children and adolescents whose signs and symptoms suggest Reye's syndrome.
cite.note: Seção ADVERSE REACTIONS (Jaundice): icterícia de padrão obstrutivo, em geral reversível com a retirada, mas há relatos de icterícia crônica; se houver febre com sintomas gripais, fazer provas hepáticas e suspender se alteradas.

cite.quote: Chlorpromazine prolongs and intensifies the action of CNS depressants such as anesthetics, barbiturates and narcotics. When chlorpromazine is administered concomitantly, about ¼ to ½ the usual dosage of such agents is required.
cite.note: CONTRAINDICATIONS: não usar em coma nem na presença de grandes quantidades de depressores do SNC (álcool, barbitúricos, narcóticos). WARNINGS: evitar álcool por efeitos aditivos e hipotensão.

cite.quote: Chlorpromazine may cause somnolence, postural hypotension, motor and sensory instability, which may lead to falls and, consequently, fractures or other injuries.
cite.note: Seção PRECAUTIONS: "Thiazide diuretics may accentuate the orthostatic hypotension that may occur with phenothiazines."

cite.quote: Neonates exposed to antipsychotic drugs, during the third trimester of pregnancy are at risk for extrapyramidal and/or withdrawal symptoms following delivery.
cite.note: Seção WARNINGS (Usage in Pregnancy): "There are reported instances of prolonged jaundice, extrapyramidal signs, hyperreflexia or hyporeflexia in newborn infants whose mothers received phenothiazines."

cite.quote: Because of the potential for serious adverse reactions in nursing infants from chlorpromazine, a decision should be made whether to discontinue nursing or to discontinue the drug, taking into account the importance of the drug to the mother.

cite.locator: seção PRECAUTIONS: Leukopenia, Neutropenia and Agranulocytosis
cite.quote: In clinical trial and postmarketing experience, events of leukopenia/neutropenia and agranulocytosis have been reported temporally related to antipsychotic agents.
cite.note: Seção ADVERSE REACTIONS (Agranulocytosis): "Most cases have occurred between the fourth and tenth weeks of therapy; patients should be watched closely during that period."

cite.quote: Chlorpromazine may lower the convulsive threshold; dosage adjustments of anticonvulsants may be necessary.
As with all drugs which exert an anticholinergic effect, and/or cause mydriasis, chlorpromazine should be used with caution in patients with glaucoma.
cite.note: Seção ADVERSE REACTIONS (Autonomic Reactions) inclui retenção urinária e íleo adinâmico.

cite.quote: Antipsychotic drugs elevate prolactin levels; the elevation persists during chronic administration.
cite.note: Mesma seção: a relevância clínica da prolactina elevada é desconhecida para a maioria dos pacientes.

cite.quote: There may be, however, following abrupt withdrawal of high-dose therapy, some symptoms resembling those of physical dependence such as gastritis, nausea and vomiting, dizziness and tremulousness.
cite.note: Mesma seção: os sintomas podem ser evitados ou reduzidos com redução gradual da dose.
